From the point of view of theory, we are concerned
with the question of whether our proof is optimal and
the obtained estimates are unimprovable in the given
Assumptions 1-4. Can we get some other estimates?
In particular, is it possible to obtain direct estimates
for a convex-concave saddle without using regularization?

have only a heterogeneous case). As a simple observation, one can notice that in the homogeneous case
D = 0. But can other estimates be changed?
